question:
The line chart given below shows the number of pencil sold by two shopkeepers A and B in 5 months.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b6d6d422a31e591b7fb4bea6a7b9ae1aa1e409b5b044a7e11c84b7bdf7b4d54.png] 

Which of the following statement is correct ?

I. The number of pencil sold by A in P and Q together is 31.72 percent more than the number of pencil sold by B in S and T together.

II. The number of pencil sold by B in Q and R together is 105.88 percent of the number of pencil sold by A in P and T together.
solution:
**Calculation:**

Statement I:

Number of Pencil sold by A in P and Q together = 150 + 140 = 290

Number of Pencil sold by B in S and T together = 130 + 125 = 255

Percent of number of pencil sold by A in P and Q together to number of pencil sold by B in S and T together = 290 / 255 × 100 = 113.72%

The number of pencil sold by A in P and Q together is 13.72 percent more than the number of pencil sold by B in S and T together.

∴ Statement I is wrong.

Statement II:

Number of Pencil sold by B in Q and R together = 110 + 160 = 270

Number of Pencil sold by A in P and T together = 150 + 105 = 255

Percent of the number of pencil sold by B in Q and R together to the number of pencil sold by A in P and T together = 270/255 × 100 = 105.88%

Statement II is correct.

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
